label: late input v in long sequences starting with w/q/t
explanation: Sparse conjunctive feature. Fires only at the last 1-2 original-phase steps (t=6..8, so L=8-9 sequences mostly) and weakly at the <DEL> step; never in the copy phase and never at t<5. Strongest when the input is v (58% of mass, all top examples) and the sequence starts with w (then q, t). Magnitude is highest for input v at the final original position with first token w. Predicate (v at the last two original steps, first token w/q/t) reaches only ~0.28 F1 / ~0.38 mass recall on dev: many weak activations are on other tokens at late positions of w/q-initial sequences, and v at late positions in other sequences often does not fire. Does not fire on early positions, short sequences (L<=5), or copy outputs.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=w (+6.84), orig0=q (+5.27), orig0=t (+4.04), orig1=w (+3.76), t=7 (+3.61), orig1=q (+3.22). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.05), next_out=- (-4.02), orig1=o (-2.45), orig1=r (-2.43).
